title: Constellation route-mapping: workspace sentinel & adaptive switcher
creator: Asha Patel
description: This ticket captures the Constellation route-mapping proposal: a compact, role-aware workspace switcher and sidebar 'sentinel' that surfaces contextual dashboards, rollout controls, and cost lenses. The goal is to reduce cognitive overhead when switching tenants/projects while giving engineers and PMs a predictable place to find per-route latency and cost breakdowns. Deliverables: hi-fi Figma prototype for desktop/tablet, keyboard-first interaction spec, annotated accessibility checklist, microcopy for states (canary, fallback, degraded), and a QA checklist for A/B evaluation during the limited rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Hi-fi Figma prototype (desktop) with interactive workspace switcher and sentinel rail published
Keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels documented and pass initial axe-core checks
Design tokens and spacing tokens mapped to the component library and a storybook entry created
Annotated handoff including component states for: online, partial-degraded, fallback-to-variant, canary-rolling
Pilot rollout plan with metrics to monitor: switch latency, route errors, help center clicks, increase in dashboard visits per switch
comments: 2026-02-12 | Asha Patel: Initial sketch review completed with PM and Eng. Agreed to prioritize keyboard interactions and accessibility before visual polish.
2026-02-19 | Riley Chen: Prototype branch created (figma). Need Eng input on the sentinel data contract (what cost metrics to surface per route). Asked Eng to propose a minimal telemetry payload.

2026-02-24 | Mateo Rivera (ENG): Proposed payload: route_id, model_variant, avg_latency_95, tokens_per_min, cost_per_1000_tokens, last_degraded_flag. Shared draft schema in RFC: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Route+Sentinel+Telemetry

2026-03-02 | Asha Patel: Usability session #1 notes: new users expect the switcher to remember last active dashboard per workspace. Suggestion: persistent 'pinned lens' per workspace (cost, latency, rollouts).

2026-03-05 | Design Review (PM+Eng+Design): Decided to surface up to 3 lenses in the sentinel: Overview, Cost, Rollouts. Secondary lenses accessible via 'More' menu. Action: Add microcopy for empty states and network error state.
2026-03-09 | Riley Chen: Accessibility pass 1 complete. Focus order validated for main switcher and sentinel controls. Need Eng to implement aria-live region for rollout status updates.
decision_log: 2026-02-19: Use a compact sentinel (40–64px rail) instead of full-width flyout to minimize context switching cost
2026-02-24: Limit sentinel primary lenses to 3 to keep cognitive load low; allow expansion for power users
2026-03-05: Adopt persistent pinned lens per workspace (user preference saved in backend) to reduce repeated navigation
2026-03-05: Rollout controls shown conditionally based on user role (devops/owner sees full controls, developer sees view-only)

Add empty/error microcopy and push updated figma frames
Create Storybook story with keyboard nav demo and unit tests for focus states
Coordinate limited canary rollout with Growth to 10 internal teams and capture metrics
